card.name: Words before drug-interaction and combination terms
card.fires_on: The word "Drug" or "drug" just before "interaction", and linking words like "including" or "with" in combination-therapy text. It also fires on odd spots inside brand names and dose units.

modes.label: Drug before interaction
modes.description: The word drug right before the word interaction(s) in headings or study descriptions.

modes.label: Combination linking words
modes.description: Words like including or with that introduce a partner drug in combination therapy.
